changelog: Version 2.3 • Pack prices lowered to about $4.75 market price. • Duel AI no longer plays Mystical Space Typhoon and similar cards on its own Spells/Traps when you have none. • Card pictures in duels now load from your PC and are cached, so they appear straight away. • Fixed the oversized background with a box in the YuGiOh Card Shop phone app. • New: you'll be told in-game when an update is available, with the changelog.
